invariants_checked: index.html, embed.html, nginx configs, vite.config.ts, and public runtime scripts load zero external CDN <script>/<link> assets and preserve air-gapped offline operation.

public/genyee-widget.js validates embedUrl against http:/https: origins with non-null origin before assigning iframe.src or calling postMessage, enforces safe CSS color values, prevents allow-scripts + allow-same-origin sandbox escape on same-origin embeds, and bounds numeric panel dimensions/refresh TTLs with Number.isFinite.

index.html Lite last-path restore preserves URL search and hash fragments (including #oidc_result / #oidc_error OIDC callbacks and ?cmdk deep links) and rejects control-character or backslash paths; package.json.md5 matches package.json.
frontend/LICENSE, frontend/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, and vendored frontend/public/tdesign-icons/** remain untouched.

findings.summary: createWidget concatenated opts.baseUrl / data-base-url into iframe.src without verifying http:/https: scheme or non-null origin (allowing javascript:/data: iframe execution) and accepted non-finite Infinity/NaN width, height, and expiresIn values.
findings.regression_test: W6-BR-01: genyee-widget.js rejects javascript:, data:, and protocol-less baseUrl and non-finite dimensions

findings.summary: Inline Lite last-path restore in index.html overwrote window.location via history.replaceState on '/' even when URL hash/search carried #oidc_result/#oidc_error OIDC callback tokens or ?cmdk queries, and package.json.md5 lagged behind package.json.
findings.regression_test: W6-BR-02: index.html Lite restore preserves URL hash/search (e.g. OIDC callback) and package.json.md5 matches package.json

invariants_checked: All REST and SSE API modules align with backend /api/v1/* endpoints, SSE event contracts, Embed vs Bearer auth separation, and GENYEE localStorage keys with zero legacy brand residues.

Hierarchical wiki slugs clamp dot-segments (., .., %2e, %2e%2e) within the slug prefix so WHATWG URL normalization cannot escape /api/v1/knowledgebase/{kbId}/wiki/pages/, and dynamic path segments (kbId, folderId, issueId, session_id, message_id, channelId) are URL-encoded.
useStream bounds per-turn memory without retaining unread SSE event arrays across turns and preserves single-flight 401 refresh + session/tenant context guards.

Embed snippet builders honour resolveEmbedBaseUrl() when explicit baseUrl is omitted, escape single quotes in generated JS server examples, and route multimodal initialization tests through authenticated postUpload.

findings.summary: encodeSlugPath left '.' and '..' unescaped (and %2e/%2e%2e normalizes under WHATWG URL parsing), allowing crafted wiki slugs to traverse above /wiki/pages/, while kbId, folderId, and issueId path segments were interpolated unencoded.
findings.regression_test: W6-API-01: wiki encodeSlugPath neutralizes dot-segment path traversal and wiki endpoints URL-encode kbId/folderId/issueId

findings.summary: useStream interpolated params.session_id and GET message_id into SSE request URLs without encodeURIComponent and pushed every parsed SSE event into an unread closure buffer array that grew without bound across turns.
findings.regression_test: W6-API-02: useStream encodes session_id and message_id in SSE URLs and does not retain unbounded SSE event buffers

findings.summary: ensureEmbedMessageSuggestions omitted encodeURIComponent on channelId/sessionId/messageId, safeBaseUrl fell back to window.location.origin instead of resolveEmbedBaseUrl() (ignoring RUNTIME_CONFIG.EMBED_BASE_URL), and single quotes in channelId were unescaped in Node server snippet strings.
findings.regression_test: W6-API-03: embed API URL-encodes suggestion path segments, honours EMBED_BASE_URL fallback, and escapes single quotes in JS snippets

findings.summary: testMultimodalFunction used raw fetch without 401 refresh retry, upload timeout scaling, or backend data.error.message extraction.
findings.regression_test: W6-API-04: testMultimodalFunction extracts structured backend error.message and routes through authenticated upload client

invariants_checked: Deployment capability gates fail closed on privileged Docker/host/remote/user-allocation sandbox capabilities while preserving standard edition defaults.
Settings route/section normalization and SYSTEM_ADMIN_SETTINGS_SECTIONS enforce single-source-of-truth RBAC and system-admin section mappings.
Runtime integration URL getters (getChromeExtensionUrl, getClawhubSkillUrl) accept only well-formed http:/https: URLs.

findings.summary: getChromeExtensionUrl and getClawhubSkillUrl returned raw __RUNTIME_CONFIG__ strings without validating http:/https: protocol before window.open / anchor rendering.
findings.regression_test: W6-CFG-01: getChromeExtensionUrl and getClawhubSkillUrl allow only http(s) URLs

invariants_checked: Navigation guards enforce authentication, workspace onboarding, deployment capability checks, and system-admin restrictions across both direct routes and redirected /platform/settings sections.

OIDC hash callback detection parses URLSearchParams for non-empty oidc_result/oidc_error parameters (preventing substring or empty-value auth-guard bypasses) and routes unauthenticated OIDC callbacks to /login#... instead of mounting protected /platform views.
Lite last-path session restore never overwrites explicit query parameters or URL hashes and rejects unsafe path characters.

findings.summary: hasPendingOIDCCallback matched substring/empty 'oidc_result='/'oidc_error=' in window.location.hash, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass router.beforeEach via '#foo_oidc_error=1' or '#oidc_error=' and mounting protected /platform views on '/' OIDC callbacks.
findings.regression_test: W6-RT-01: OIDC callback detection rejects substring/empty hash bypasses and sends unauthenticated OIDC callbacks to /login preserving hash

findings.summary: Vue Router resolved /platform/system/* route redirects to /platform/settings?section=... before router.beforeEach ran, leaving to.meta.requiresSystemAdmin undefined and permitting non-system-admins to navigate to SYSTEM_ADMIN_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.
findings.regression_test: W6-RT-02: router blocks non-system-admins from /platform/system/* redirects and SYSTEM_ADMIN_SETTINGS_SECTIONS

invariants_checked: Logout, cross-tab token removal, account switch, and workspace switch atomically scrub tenant-scoped localStorage keys (GENYEE_settings, genyee_last_chat_model_id, genyee_current_kb), revoke protected blob ObjectURLs, and reset in-memory Pinia stores (settings, chatResources, editorResources, organization, modelProviders, browserConnection, menu, ui, uploadConfirm, knowledge, deploymentCapabilities, assistant).

Async store fetches (auth/me, pendingInvitationCount, organization members/preview/search, modelProviders, browserConnection polling) are fenced by generation/epoch counters so pre-logout or pre-switch responses cannot repopulate state.
deploymentCapabilitiesStore remains retryable after transient network/auth errors rather than permanently latching loaded=true.

findings.summary: logout() and setUser() account switches left tenant-scoped GENYEE_settings (selectedTags, selectedMCPServices, selectedSkills, apiKey, modelConfig) in localStorage and retained stale in-memory settingsStore, modelProviders, browserConnection, sidebar chat menu, UI manualEditor/tag state, pending uploadConfirm promises, and assistant drafts across SPA re-logins.
findings.regression_test: W6-ST-01: logout and user switch scrub tenant-scoped localStorage and reset in-memory settingsStore, modelProviders, browserConnection, menu, ui, uploadConfirm, and assistant transient state

findings.summary: Cross-tab genyee_token removal left in-memory user/tenant/memberships/isSystemAdmin populated, and fetchPendingInvitationCount lacked a sessionEpoch guard against post-logout writeback.
findings.regression_test: W6-ST-02: cross-tab token removal clears user/tenant principals and late fetchPendingInvitationCount cannot repopulate logged-out session

findings.summary: In-flight preview, fetchMembers, and fetchSearchableOrganizations requests in useOrganizationStore lacked stateGeneration/request-sequence fencing and could repopulate cleared state after clearState().
findings.regression_test: W6-ST-03: organizationStore clearState fences in-flight fetchMembers, fetchSearchableOrganizations, and preview against cross-tenant writeback

findings.summary: ensureLoaded set loaded.value = true inside finally even when getDeploymentCapabilities threw, preventing subsequent ensureLoaded() calls from retrying after transient failures.
findings.regression_test: W6-ST-04: deploymentCapabilitiesStore retries after transient load failure instead of latching loaded=true

invariants_checked: Test helpers (createStorageStub, flushMicrotasks) touch zero production code paths, isolate per-test Map storage cleanly, and contain zero host paths or legacy brand residues.

Type-only ambient and domain declarations (knowledge-base, knowledgeProcess, menu, shims-vue, tool-results, web-search) emit zero runtime executable code, preserve strict contract parity with backend DTOs, and contain zero legacy brand residues.

Markdown, KaTeX, Mermaid, citation, EPUB, and XLSX HTML/SVG pipelines block javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html and executable data:image/svg+xml / <foreignObject> / external <use> payloads in real browser DOMPurify and headless fallbacks.
Axios request/response interceptors never leak Authorization Bearer tokens, X-Tenant-ID headers, or 401 token-refresh retries to cross-origin URLs or untokened /api/v1/embed/ endpoints.

Protected file blob caches and citation chunk caches enforce userId:tenantId scoping, clearEpoch/scope fencing across async fetches, bounded cache capacity, and complete ObjectURL revocation on logout/switch.

Page snapshot/text helpers redact camelCase, snake_case, and [data-assistant-redact] secrets; reference/docs/page-link URL helpers enforce http(s) or safe in-app paths with zero external Google favicon requests.

findings.summary: preprocessCitationTags and stripCitationTagsForMarkdown allowed javascript:/non-http(s) URLs in <web url="..."/> (persisting into data-url click handlers and saved Markdown), interpolated unescaped domain text into HTML, and mutated [[...]] / <kb/> / <web/> inside fenced and inline code blocks.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-01: citationMarkdown blocks javascript:/data: web URLs, escapes domain HTML, and leaves code blocks untouched

findings.summary: domPurifyAllowedUriRegexp allowed arbitrary data:image/* (including data:image/svg+xml on SVG <use>/<a>/<image>), ALLOWED_TAGS permitted <foreignObject>, hooks missed arbitrary on* attributes and lowercase SVG <a> target/noopener handling, and DOMPurifyConfig stripped EPUB <section data-epub-section> wrappers.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-02: DOMPurify configs/hooks block SVG data:image/svg+xml XSS, foreignObject, event attrs, lowercase SVG <a> opener leaks, and preserve EPUB sections in real browser DOMPurify

findings.summary: buildProtectedImageTag interpolated decoded " characters into data-protected-src without escaping (allowing attribute breakout prior to sanitization), createSafeImage escaped only double quotes, hydrateProtectedFileImages lacked active scope re-checks across awaits, and clearProtectedFileCache did not clear citationChunkCache.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-03: security.ts escapes decoded quotes in protected image tags, fences hydrateProtectedFileImages on scope change, and clears citationChunkCache on protected cache reset

findings.summary: renderEpubPreview minted navigable same-origin image/svg+xml blob: URLs for archive .svg entries and passed raw inline data:image/svg+xml through unsanitized, while extractXlsxCellImages embedded raw xl/media/*.svg bytes as base64 data URLs without stripping scripts/event handlers and injectSheetHtmlImages left img.src unescaped.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-04: renderEpubPreview and extractXlsxCellImages sanitize embedded SVG media to static data URLs without minting executable SVG blob URLs

findings.summary: Axios request and 401 response interceptors attached Bearer JWTs and X-Tenant-ID headers and ran token-refresh retries even on cross-origin URLs and untokened /api/v1/embed/ requests.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-05: request.ts never leaks Authorization or X-Tenant-ID headers or 401 refresh retries to cross-origin URLs or untokened embed paths

findings.summary: isSecretLabel relied on \b word boundaries that failed to match camelCase and snake_case credential field names/IDs (e.g. openai_api_key, clientSecret, confirmPassword, slack_bot_token), and snapshotPage did not skip non-field [data-assistant-redact] containers/cells.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-06: isSecretLabel detects camelCase and snake_case credential field names/ids

findings.summary: getKnowledgeChunksSummaryHtml interpolated uncoerced fetched_chunks/total_chunks into v-html strings, replaceIncompleteImageWithPlaceholder truncated settled prose/code containing '![' (such as Rust vec![1]) followed by '(', and citationChunkCache grew without bound.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-07: getKnowledgeChunksSummaryHtml escapes/coerces untrusted counts, renderChatMarkdown preserves settled code with ![ and (, and citationChunkCache is bounded

findings.summary: Hardened URL/input validation across remaining utils: blocked non-http(s) web reference URLs and removed external google.com/s2/favicons domain leaks in referenceSources, rejected unsafe schemes/control chars in docsUrl and pageLinkReturnPath, sanitized string SVG diagrams + deduplicated click listeners in mermaidViewer, enforced fence boundaries in mermaidStreaming, stripped ANSI escapes before secret-prompt detection in ptyEchoPredictor, escaped CR/LF in embedContext, rejected dotless filenames in fileTypeVerification, and rejected IP/TLD wildcards in embedAllowedOrigins.
findings.regression_test: W6-UT-08: referenceSources blocks unsafe web URLs and external Google favicon leaks, docsUrl and pageLinkReturnPath reject unsafe targets, and misc utils harden edge cases

invariants_checked: Generated Wails desktop IPC bindings (App.js, App.d.ts, models.ts, runtime.js, runtime.d.ts) invoke only local window.go / window.runtime bridges, execute zero dynamic eval/network code, and align with GENYEE desktop models.
